item.text: The September registration in the repo has a ledger resolutionDate of 2026-10-28, but the official ABS Labour Force page currently schedules the September 2026 release for 2026-10-15. I’ll keep the registered target binding and state the discrepancy in the reasoning, as requested.

I found prior Thesis analyst runs for June, July, and August targets. I’m only using those as public run artifacts when they expose official ABS history, not as authority for this forecast’s estimate.

The official latest-release table exposes the same seasonally adjusted employed-person variant through July 2026. For the forecast sample, I’m using the month-over-month changes implied by those fetched ABS levels, with the July monthly change cross-checking to the ABS headline -15.8 thousand print.
